title: Do not buy under any circumstances. It’s awful.
text:
Do not buy under any circumstances. It’s awful.. I decided to take a chance on a super cheap recliner and although I’m not in love with it it’s not bad for the price. It’s a bit stiff but it’s brand new so that seems to be expected. The only real issue is the head support. There is a ton of padding up to your shoulders but nothing really behind your head. If it am reclined and my head is back I’m basically looking at the ceiling. It is solved by putting a pillow behind my head but I wish the top of the back had more cushion for head support. Assembly was pretty easy and it looks nice. Do not buy this chair based on its massage function. It is not a massage chair. What they are calling “massage” is pretty much just the chair buzzing in different spots.

Update: this chair is just plain awful. Do not purchase it for any reason. If I sat in it for more than 10 minutes my hips and shoulders would start to hurt. The leg part is so short that it barely came to my knees. It is just an overall poorly made and awful chair. I’ve sat in church pews that were more comfortable. I ended up having to go to a store to buy one that I could sit in first.
